Built for real teams, not project managers.

Boards and timelines

See every project at a glance.

Drag tasks between columns, switch to a timeline to spot clashes, or filter by person to see who's overloaded.

  • Task templates for repeat work
  • Deadlines and reminders that actually get read
Reports

Know what's on track before anyone asks.

Weekly reports are created for you. See progress, time spent and risks in one page you can send to your boss or client.

  • Automatic weekly progress reports
  • Built-in time tracking
  • Workload view for every team member
Client portal

Share progress with clients, not your inbox.

Give clients a clean view of their project, where they can approve work and leave comments. No more lost email threads.

  • Branded client portal
  • One-click approvals on files and designs
  • Comments on any task or file

Works on any device

Questions

Is Relay really free?

Yes. The Free plan is free forever for teams of up to five people, with unlimited tasks and three projects. No credit card needed.

Can I move my projects from another tool?

Yes. Import from Trello, Asana, Monday or a spreadsheet in a few clicks. Our team will help for free on the Business plan.

How does per-user pricing work?

You pay for each team member with an account. Clients using the portal are always free.

Can I cancel any time?

Yes. Cancel from your settings page. Monthly plans stop at the end of the month and yearly plans can be refunded for unused months.

Get your team on the same page today.

# Saas Product

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/saas-landing/saas-product/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.
Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.
Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

dependencies: Native browser APIs; no package dependencies
